messages.author: 38e260fc5780b4d6
messages.subject: c++ error: multi_normal_prec_log not declared
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying out Stan 2.0.1 and when compiling my code I get the following error:

build/st_pollen_v3.cpp: In member function ‘T__ st_pollen_v3_model_namespace::st_pollen_v3_model::log_prob(std::vector<T__>&, std::vector<int>&, std::ostream*) const’:
build/st_pollen_v3.cpp:464:32: error: ‘multi_normal_prec_log’ was not declared in this scope

It compiles fine with Stan 1.3.0.

Also, on page 311 in the manual, the sampling statement reads: multi_norm_prec and refers to multi_norm_prec_log, but the function definition is for multi_normal_prec_log.

Thoughts?

Thanks!
Andria

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] c++ error: multi_normal_prec_log not declared
parts:
This is a known bug in 2.0.1 which has been fixed.  2.0.2 should be out soon with the fix, but if you're motivated and don't want to wait you can also just grab the develop branch from Github.

Cheers,
Marcus
